text.p: The following stocks are in active in Thursday equity trading:
-- Company said it received a buyout offer at $10 a share cash from Renco Group Inc, which currently owns 84 percent of WCI. Shares hit a new 52-week intraday high of 9-5/8.
-- Time Warner shareholders overwhelmingly approved the merger with Turner Broadcasting System Inc at a special shareholders meeting this morning, creating the world's largest entertainment group.
-- Company's FoxMeyer Drug Co unit, which is operating under Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, said it has placed orders for about $140 million in new inventory.

-- The company said it expects third quarter earnings of $0.85 to $0.90 a share before a one-time charge of $0.03 to retire debt. TJX posted third quarter earnings of $0.44 a share in the year-ago quarter.
-- Shares hit new year high of 40 in intraday trading.
-- Company's third quarter earnings rise to $0.58 a share from $0.37 last year. Graco says backlog of $33 million was nearly $10 million higher than a year ago.
-- Shares rose in heavy trading after company said same-store sales for the five-week period ended October 5 were up 15.1 percent for its Footaction stores and up 13.5 percent for its CVS chain.
Same-store sales at its Linen 'n Things superstores were up 1.1 percent, it said.
-- Company posts fourth quarter profit of $2.12 a share compared to a loss last year.
